chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Sulayman ibn Sama'ah and Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim al-Batal, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah (عليه السلام) said: “Any Imam who does not know what will befall him and to what he will come, then that is not a Proof of Allah over His creation.”

key_terms.يَصِيرُ: what he will ultimately come to or proceed toward

ai.seo_question: Why must the Imam know what will happen to him according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that an Imam, as Allah’s proof over creation, must possess knowledge of what will befall him and what his ultimate course will be. It emphasizes the theological rank of the Imam and the necessity of divinely granted knowledge as part of valid religious authority.
